name: genpark-personal-agent-biometric-sleep-readiness-workload-allocator-skill
description: Personal Agent Biometric Sleep & Readiness Workload Allocator. Ingests sleep debt, REM/Deep ratios, and HRV recovery metrics to calculate an objective cognitive readiness index and dynamically reschedule high-intensity deep work blocks.

tools.name: allocate_cognitive_workload
tools.description: Align daily calendar tasks with user biometric recovery score and circadian capacity.

planned_tasks.description: Tasks with name, cognitive_demand (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW), duration_mins.
